validated_targets.experimental_detail: PRPS2 uses non-conserved residues to bypass ADP/GDP feedback inhibition, enabling sustained ATP production, and directly stabilizes MAT2A to stimulate SAM synthesis for RNA m6A methylation via the WTAP/METTL3/METTL14 complex, promoting lung tumorigenesis.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: ZD6126 selectively disrupts the tubulin cytoskeleton of endothelial cells, and in nude mice bearing PC14PE6 lung adenocarcinoma, ZD6126 alone induced endothelial apoptosis; combination with cisplatin enhanced this apoptosis and significantly reduced lung metastases.

title: Sensitization of tumor-associated endothelial cell apoptosis by the novel vascular-targeting agent ZD6126 in combination with cisplatin.
journal: Clinical cancer research : an official journal of the American Association for Cancer Research

disease: lung, ovary, breast, prostate, and colorectal cancer
title: Cross-Cancer Genome-Wide Analysis of Lung, Ovary, Breast, Prostate, and Colorectal Cancer Reveals Novel Pleiotropic Associations.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Suppression of endogenous micro-calpain expression or treatment with calpain inhibitors calpeptin and PD150606 reduced cisplatin-induced apoptosis, caspase-9/-3 activities, and completely blocked AIF redistribution in human lung adenocarcinoma cells.

title: Micro-calpain regulates caspase-dependent and apoptosis inducing factor-mediated caspase-independent apoptotic pathways in cisplatin-induced apoptosis.

validated_targets.specific_model_name: Hs746T, SNU1750, MKN1, SK4, SNU484, SNU668, YCC11, MKN45, SNU719 cell lines; GA077 xenografts in BALB/c nude mice; 942 patient gastric cancer tissues

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Knockdown of NAPRT in MKN45 and SNU719 cells sensitized them to FK866; overexpression of NAPRT in MKN1 and SNU484 cells protected them from FK866-mediated toxicity.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: MKN45, SNU719, MKN1, SNU484 cell lines; GA077 and MKN45 xenografts; 942 patient gastric cancer tissues

evidence_summary: Coexpression of BRAF(V600E) and PIK3CA(H1047R) in mouse lung epithelium dramatically decreased tumor latency, increased tumor burden, and elicited lung adenocarcinomas; derived cell line analyses provided mechanistic clues about cooperative regulation of cell division and apoptosis.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Expression of mutationally activated PIK3CA(H1047R) alone or with PTEN silencing had no phenotype; coexpression with BRAF(V600E) dramatically decreased tumor latency and increased tumor burden, promoting progression to lung adenocarcinoma.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: Mice with conditional Pik3ca H1047R knock-in allele

validated_targets.experimental_detail: BRAF(V600E) alone induced benign lung tumorigenesis; coexpression with PIK3CA(H1047R) led to malignant lung adenocarcinoma with decreased latency and increased tumor burden, and derived cells revealed cooperative regulation of cell cycle and apoptosis.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: Mice expressing BRAF V600E in lung epithelium and derived lung cancer cell lines

title: Mutationally activated PIK3CA(H1047R) cooperates with BRAF(V600E) to promote lung cancer progression.

evidence_summary: Transgenic expression of KRAS(G12D) in differentiated AT1 cells reprogrammed them into AT2 stem cells forming indolent lung tumors; concomitant WNT activation and augmentation of ERK activity altered tumor proliferation and progression in mouse models.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Expression of KRAS(G12D) in differentiated AT1 cells drove reprogramming into AT2 stem cells and formation of indolent lepidic adenocarcinoma.
Augmentation of ERK activity in KRAS(G12D)-expressing AT1 cells increased transformation efficiency, proliferation, and progression to mixed tumor histology.
Concomitant WNT activation with KRAS(G12D) induction accelerated AT2-derived but inhibited AT1-derived adenoma proliferation.

title: KRAS(G12D) drives lepidic adenocarcinoma through stem-cell reprogramming.

evidence_summary: Blocking factor H/FHL-1 activity with specific antibodies in H1264 lung adenocarcinoma cells increased C3 deposition, C5a release, and complement-mediated cytotoxicity, demonstrating their protective role.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Blocking factor H/FHL-1 with specific antibodies in H1264 lung adenocarcinoma cells enhanced C3 fragment deposition, increased anaphylatoxin C5a release, and moderately increased complement-mediated cytotoxicity, confirming protection against complement activation.

title: Expression of complement factor H by lung cancer cells: effects on the activation of the alternative pathway of complement.

evidence_summary: IL-10 treatment in a human lung adenocarcinoma cell line under metabolic restrictions inhibited PD-L1 expression and tumor cell apoptosis, demonstrating a functional role in immune evasion and survival.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: In a human lung adenocarcinoma cell line under metabolic restriction, IL-10 treatment inhibited PD-L1 expression and tumor cell apoptosis.

title: Interleukin-10-regulated tumour tolerance in non-small cell lung cancer.

evidence_summary: Functional assays demonstrated that the T allele of rs17079281 increases YY1 binding affinity, suppressing DCBLD1 expression; DCBLD1 promotes lung adenocarcinoma cell growth by influencing cell cycle progression, acting as an oncogene.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: T allele of rs17079281 creates a YY1-binding site that suppresses DCBLD1 expression; DCBLD1 promotes tumor growth by influencing cell cycle progression.

title: SNP rs17079281 decreases lung cancer risk through creating an YY1-binding site to suppress DCBLD1 expression.

evidence_summary: Genome-wide CRISPR/Cas9 screen identified APC/C complex members as resistance mediators; CRISPR/Cas9 knockout and siRNA knockdown validated that disruption of APC/C confers resistance to the TTK inhibitor CFI-402257 in TNBC cell lines.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: CRISPR/Cas9 knockout and siRNA knockdown of APC/C complex members in multiple TNBC cell lines conferred resistance to the TTK inhibitor CFI-402257.

title: Disruption of the anaphase-promoting complex confers resistance to TTK inhibitors in triple-negative breast cancer.
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America

evidence_summary: miR-31 overexpression in human lung adenocarcinoma and squamous cell carcinoma cell lines promoted tumor growth in xenograft models; in large- and small-cell carcinoma lines it promoted spontaneous metastasis without affecting primary tumor growth.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: miR-31 promoted tumor growth in xenografted human adenocarcinoma and squamous cell carcinoma cell lines; in large- and small-cell carcinoma lines, it did not promote primary tumor growth but promoted spontaneous metastasis.

title: miR-31 Displays Subtype Specificity in Lung Cancer.

evidence_summary: PrP^C expression manipulation in EGFR-mutated NSCLC cell lines demonstrated that PrP^C is required for maintaining mesenchymal phenotype, operates through ILK-RBPJ cascade, and its reduction sensitizes cells to osimertinib; plasma PrP^C levels correlated with disease status in patients.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Knockdown or overexpression of PRNP in EGFR-mutated NSCLC cell lines showed PrP^C drives epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition and TKI resistance; reducing PRNP expression sensitized cells to osimertinib; plasma PrP^C levels were elevated in EGFR-mutated NSCLC patients and mirrored disease evolution.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: EGFR-mutated NSCLC cell lines, patient plasma cohorts

title: PrP<sup>C</sup> controls epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition in EGFR-mutated NSCLC: implications for TKI resistance and patient follow-up.

evidence_summary: Vaccination with peptides presented by LUAD in vivo induced CD8+ T cell responses in naive mice and tumor-bearing mice, demonstrating the immunogenicity of these peptide antigens.
title: Deciphering the immunopeptidome in vivo reveals new tumour antigens.

evidence_summary: Radioreceptor assays showed NNK binds beta1- and beta2-adrenergic receptors with high affinity; NNK treatment increased DNA synthesis and arachidonic acid release in two lung adenocarcinoma cell lines, effects blocked by beta-adrenergic antagonists.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: NNK bound to ADRB1 with high affinity; NNK-induced DNA synthesis and arachidonic acid release in lung adenocarcinoma cells were blocked by beta-adrenergic antagonists.
NNK bound to ADRB2 with high affinity; NNK-induced DNA synthesis and arachidonic acid release in lung adenocarcinoma cells were blocked by beta-adrenergic antagonists.

title: The tobacco-specific carcinogen 4-(methylnitrosamino)-1-(3-pyridyl)-1-butanone is a beta-adrenergic agonist and stimulates DNA synthesis in lung adenocarcinoma via beta-adrenergic receptor-mediated release of arachidonic acid.

title: Preclinical antitumor efficacy of the polyamine analogue N1, N11-diethylnorspermine administered by multiple injection or continuous infusion.

evidence_summary: Growth inhibition studies in the NCI-H820 lung adenocarcinoma cell line with MET amplification showed that cells are resistant to EGFR inhibitors erlotinib and CL-387,785 but sensitive to the multikinase inhibitor XL880 with potent MET activity, validating MET as a therapeutic target.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: NCI-H820 cells with MET amplification were resistant to EGFR inhibitors erlotinib and CL-387,785 but sensitive to the MET-active multikinase inhibitor XL880 in growth inhibition studies.

title: MET amplification occurs with or without T790M mutations in EGFR mutant lung tumors with acquired resistance to gefitinib or erlotinib.
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America

evidence_summary: PAX6 was demonstrated to promote lung cancer stemness via GLI-mediated transcriptional activation of SOX2; GLI directly binds SOX2 promoter; blockade of the PAX6-GLI-SOX2 axis limited CSC expansion and enhanced chemotherapy efficacy.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: PAX6 drives cancer stemness properties; silencing or blockade of its downstream axis limits CSC expansion.
GLI transcriptionally activates SOX2 by binding to its proximal promoter, mediating PAX6-induced stemness.
SOX2 is directly upregulated by GLI binding to its promoter and enhances pluripotent factors (OCT4, NANOG) while suppressing differentiation factors (HOPX, NKX2-1).
Blockade of the axis reduces CSC expansion and improves chemotherapy efficacy in LUAD.

title: Epigenetically regulated PAX6 drives cancer cells toward a stem-like state via GLI-SOX2 signaling axis in lung adenocarcinoma.

evidence_summary: Ectopic AXL overexpression increased invasiveness and drug resistance; sulfasalazine and IκB dominant-negative transfectants suppressed NF-κB signaling and AXL phosphorylation, reducing invasiveness and enhancing doxorubicin efficacy in CL1 lung adenocarcinoma sublines.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Ectopic overexpression of AXL elevated cell invasiveness and drug resistance in CL1 lung adenocarcinoma sublines.

Inhibition of NF-κB by sulfasalazine or IκB dominant-negative transfectants suppressed invasiveness and doxorubicin resistance, and abolished phosphorylation of AXL and other RTKs in CL1 sublines and AXL-expressing cancer cells.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: CL1 sublines and various AXL-expressing cancer cell lines

title: Sulfasalazine suppresses drug resistance and invasiveness of lung adenocarcinoma cells expressing AXL.

evidence_summary: LKB1 inactivation in Kras(G12D);Lkb1(lox/lox) mouse model revealed redox imbalance driving ADC-to-SCC transdifferentiation; pentose phosphate pathway deregulation and impaired fatty acid oxidation functionally contributed to tumor plasticity and drug resistance.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: LKB1 inactivation in Kras(G12D);Lkb1(lox/lox) mouse model led to differential ROS levels, affected ADC-to-SCC transdifferentiation, and modulated therapeutic response to metabolic stress.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: Kras(G12D);Lkb1(lox/lox) mouse model and human NSCLC samples

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Pentose phosphate pathway deregulation contributed to redox imbalance and functionally affected ADC-to-SCC transdifferentiation.
Impaired fatty acid oxidation contributed to redox imbalance and functionally affected ADC-to-SCC transdifferentiation.

title: LKB1 Inactivation Elicits a Redox Imbalance to Modulate Non-small Cell Lung Cancer Plasticity and Therapeutic Response.

evidence_summary: CRISPR-mediated inactivation of Setd2, Arid1a, and Smarca4 in KrasG12D-driven mouse models of lung adenocarcinoma, with gene expression profiling, identifying Setd2 as a potent tumor suppressor.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: CRISPR-mediated Setd2 inactivation in mouse lung adenocarcinoma models led to rapid expansion and accelerated progression of tumors, identifying it as a potent tumor suppressor.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: KrasG12D-driven mouse models of lung adenocarcinoma

validated_targets.experimental_detail: CRISPR-mediated Arid1a inactivation in mouse lung adenocarcinoma models was selected against in early-stage tumors but promoted higher grade lesions over time.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: KrasG12D-driven mouse models of lung adenocarcinoma

validated_targets.experimental_detail: CRISPR-mediated Smarca4 inactivation in mouse lung adenocarcinoma models was selected against in early-stage tumors and limited disease progression.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: KrasG12D-driven mouse models of lung adenocarcinoma

title: Systematic In Vivo Inactivation of Chromatin-Regulating Enzymes Identifies Setd2 as a Potent Tumor Suppressor in Lung Adenocarcinoma.

evidence_summary: Treatment with selective MEK inhibitors MSC19363669B and selumetinib inhibited proliferation, invasion, migration, anchorage-independent growth in vitro and tumor growth in vivo in TKI-resistant CALU-3 lung adenocarcinoma xenograft models.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Treatment with MEK inhibitors MSC19363669B and selumetinib inhibited proliferation, invasion, migration, anchorage-independent growth in vitro and tumor growth in vivo in TKI-resistant CALU-3 cells.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: TKI-resistant CALU-3 cells, athymic nude mice xenografts

title: Antitumour efficacy of MEK inhibitors in human lung cancer cells and their derivatives with acquired resistance to different tyrosine kinase inhibitors.

evidence_summary: Genetic, pharmacological, and chemogenetic disruption of the vagal sensory-sympathetic pathway inhibited lung tumor growth by enhancing anti-tumor immunity in mouse models.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Genetic or chemogenetic disruption of Npy2r-expressing vagal sensory neurons suppressed tumor growth by enhancing anti-tumor immune responses.
Blockade of β2 adrenergic signalling in alveolar macrophages enhanced anti-tumor immunity and inhibited lung tumor growth.

title: Tumour-brain crosstalk restrains cancer immunity via a sensory-sympathetic axis.

evidence_summary: Treatment with B[a]P-7,8-trans-dihydrodiol in A549 cells increased ROS, DNA strand breaks, and 8-oxo-dGuo, confirming AKR-mediated activation; COMT inhibitor enhanced genotoxicity, indicating protective role of COMT.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Treatment of A549 cells with B[a]P-7,8-trans-dihydrodiol, an AKR substrate, led to increased ROS, DNA damage, and 8-oxo-dGuo, indicating AKR-mediated metabolic activation contributes to genotoxicity.
Inhibition of COMT enhanced B[a]P-7,8-trans-dihydrodiol-induced DNA damage, suggesting COMT protects against o-quinone-mediated redox cycling.

title: Evidence for the aldo-keto reductase pathway of polycyclic aromatic trans-dihydrodiol activation in human lung A549 cells.
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America

evidence_summary: In gp130F/F:KrasG12D mouse model of lung adenocarcinoma, genetic ablation of Il6 or normalization of STAT3 activation abrogated cachexia, and anti-IL-6R antibody blockade of IL-6 trans-signalling ameliorated muscle wasting, validating IL-6/STAT3 axis as a therapeutic target.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Genetic ablation of Il6 in gp130F/F:KrasG12D mice abrogated cachexia, indicating IL-6 requirement for muscle wasting.
Anti-IL-6R antibody specifically blocking IL-6 trans-signalling ameliorated cachexia in gp130F/F:KrasG12D mice.
Genetic normalization of STAT3 activation (Stat3-/+ heterozygosity) abrogated cachexia in gp130F/F:KrasG12D mice.
Blockade of the IL-6 trans-signalling/STAT3 axis via genetic ablation of Il6 or Stat3 reduction, or anti-IL-6R antibody, suppressed cachexia in lung adenocarcinoma mice.

title: Blockade of the IL-6 trans-signalling/STAT3 axis suppresses cachexia in Kras-induced lung adenocarcinoma.

evidence_summary: Gprc5a knockout mice developed high incidence of lung adenomas and adenocarcinomas; GPRC5A overexpression suppressed colony formation in semisolid medium in human embryonic kidney, human non-small-cell lung cancer, and mouse lung adenocarcinoma cells.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Gprc5a knockout mice showed 76% adenoma and 17% adenocarcinoma incidence vs low incidence in wild-type; GPRC5A overexpression reduced colony formation by 91%, 91%, and 68% in HEK293, human NSCLC, and mouse lung adenocarcinoma cells, respectively.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: Gprc5a knockout mice, HEK293 cells, human NSCLC cells, mouse lung adenocarcinoma cells

title: Identification of the retinoic acid-inducible Gprc5a as a new lung tumor suppressor gene.
journal: Journal of the National Cancer Institute

evidence_summary: Restoration of CLDN18.1 expression in lung adenocarcinoma cells suppressed xenograft tumor growth in vivo and cell proliferation, migration, invasion, and colony formation in vitro; CLDN18.1 inhibited IGF-1R/AKT phosphorylation and decreased YAP/TAZ protein levels, with YAP/TAZ siRNA confirming their involvement in AKT inactivation.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Overexpression of CLDN18.1 in lung adenocarcinoma cells that had lost endogenous expression attenuated malignant properties in vitro and xenograft tumor growth in vivo.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: human lung adenocarcinoma cell lines and xenograft mouse model

validated_targets.experimental_detail: siRNA-mediated silencing of YAP1 suggested its involvement in CLDN18.1-mediated AKT inactivation in lung adenocarcinoma cells.
siRNA-mediated silencing of TAZ (WWTR1) showed that inhibition of TAZ contributes to CLDN18.1-mediated AKT inactivation in lung adenocarcinoma cells.

title: CLDN18.1 attenuates malignancy and related signaling pathways of lung adenocarcinoma in vivo and in vitro.

evidence_summary: In vivo TNF-alpha neutralization in a mouse model of malignant pleural effusion using lung adenocarcinoma cells limited tumor dissemination, effusion formation, and angiogenesis, improving survival; TNF-alpha induced VEGF via neutral sphingomyelinase and auto-induced via NF-kappaB in cancer cells.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Tumor-derived TNF-alpha neutralization in mice reduced effusion formation, tumor dissemination, vascular permeability, and VEGF expression, and improved survival; TNF-alpha induced autocrine TNF-alpha via NF-κB and VEGF via nSMase.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: Immunocompetent mice injected intrapleurally with mouse lung adenocarcinoma cells; human cancer cell lines

title: Tumor necrosis factor-alpha promotes malignant pleural effusion.

evidence_summary: Overexpression of EPHB6 in lung adenocarcinoma cells increased adhesion and decreased migration; RNAi and overexpression approaches confirmed functional role; reexpression of EPHB6 in lung cancer cells abolished metastasis in NOD/SCID mice; 5-aza-2'-deoxycytidine treatment induced EPHB6 expression in NSCLC cell line, confirming epigenetic silencing.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Restoration of EPHB6 in lung adenocarcinoma cells increased adhesion and decreased migration; RNAi and overexpression demonstrated metastasis-suppressive function; reexpression abolished metastasis in NOD/SCID mice.

title: The EPHB6 receptor tyrosine kinase is a metastasis suppressor that is frequently silenced by promoter DNA hypermethylation in non-small cell lung cancer.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: STRAP overexpression in A549 cells enhanced anchorage-independent growth and tumorigenicity in nude mice; siRNA knockdown reduced tumorigenicity and increased TGF-beta signaling.

title: Oncogenic function of a novel WD-domain protein, STRAP, in human carcinogenesis.

evidence_summary: Reporter assay confirmed that sequences from MALAT1 and MENβ containing ENE and A-rich tract increase intronless β-globin reporter RNA levels; mutational analysis and UV thermal denaturation defined structural requirements for triple helix-mediated RNA stabilization.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: MALAT1 sequence containing the ENE and A-rich tract increased levels of an intronless β-globin reporter RNA, and mutational analysis showed intact triple helix, strong stems, and a blunt-ended triplex are required for stabilization activity.
MENβ sequence containing the predicted ENE and A-rich tract increased levels of an intronless β-globin reporter RNA, confirming triple helix-mediated RNA stabilization.

title: Formation of triple-helical structures by the 3'-end sequences of MALAT1 and MENβ noncoding RNAs.

evidence_summary: Lkb1 restoration in KRAS-driven lung tumors in mice suppressed proliferation and resulted in tumor stasis; C/EBPα was shown to constrain tumor growth in vivo.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Restoration of Lkb1 in oncogenic KRAS-driven lung tumors suppressed proliferation and led to tumor stasis.
C/EBPα constrains oncogenic KRAS-driven lung tumor growth in vivo.

title: LKB1 drives stasis and C/EBP-mediated reprogramming to an alveolar type II fate in lung cancer.

evidence_summary: Cotransfection of p53 mutants with WT TP53 in multiple cancer cell lines and reporter gene assay revealed cell-type-dependent dominant negative effects on WT p53-mediated transactivation.
disease: multiple cancer types including lung adenocarcinoma, mesothelioma, prostate carcinoma, osteosarcoma, hepatocellular carcinoma, ovarian carcinoma, breast cancer

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Missense p53 mutants (e.g., 248trp, 273his) were cotransfected with WT TP53 into TP53-null cell lines from various cancers; effects on transactivation of a PG13-CAT reporter were measured, showing cell-type-dependent inhibition, no effect, or enhancement.

title: Effects of p53 mutants on wild-type p53-mediated transactivation are cell type dependent.

evidence_summary: GGTI-298 (geranylgeranyltransferase I inhibitor) and FTI-277 (farnesyltransferase inhibitor) treatment in A549 lung adenocarcinoma cells; flow cytometry and apoptosis assays demonstrated that geranylgeranylation controls G0-G1 progression and apoptosis, while farnesylation influences G2-M phase.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: GGTI-298 and compactin inhibited growth and induced apoptosis in A549 cells; geranylgeraniol blocked compactin-induced apoptosis, confirming that geranylgeranylation is critical for programmed cell death.
FTI-277 caused G2-M enrichment and inhibited A549 cell growth but did not induce apoptosis, indicating farnesylated proteins are involved in G2-M phase transition.

title: GGTI-298 induces G0-G1 block and apoptosis whereas FTI-277 causes G2-M enrichment in A549 cells.

evidence_summary: Dominant-negative Stat3 expression in PC14PE6/AS2 lung adenocarcinoma cells reduced VEGF expression and abrogated malignant pleural effusion and lung metastasis in an animal model, confirming Stat3's oncogenic role.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Dominant-negative Stat3 in PC14PE6/AS2 cells reduced VEGF expression and prevented malignant pleural effusion and lung metastasis in vivo.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: PC14PE6/AS2 human lung adenocarcinoma cell line, animal model (likely nude mice)

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Autocrine IL-6 activates STAT3 via JAKs, leading to VEGF upregulation and contributing to malignant pleural effusion; blocking STAT3 with dominant-negative abolished this pathway-driven phenotype.

title: Autocrine IL-6-induced Stat3 activation contributes to the pathogenesis of lung adenocarcinoma and malignant pleural effusion.

evidence_summary: N-acetylcysteine conjugate of phenethyl isothiocyanate (PEITC-NAC) treatment induced apoptosis and AP-1 activity in A549 human lung adenocarcinoma cells; overexpression of wild-type JUN cDNA greatly enhanced PEITC-NAC-mediated apoptosis, validating JUN/AP-1 as critical for apoptosis induction.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Overexpression of wild-type JUN cDNA in A549 cells greatly increased PEITC-NAC-mediated apoptosis compared to control vector-transfected cells, measured by morphology and DNA fragmentation.

title: N-acetylcysteine conjugate of phenethyl isothiocyanate enhances apoptosis in growth-stimulated human lung cells.

evidence_summary: BI-3406 (SOS1 inhibitor) impaired RAS activation and downstream signaling, reduced tumor burden in KRAS-mutant allograft models and KRASG12D-driven LUAD mice; combination with KRASG12D inhibitor MRTX1133 showed synergistic antitumor effects, confirming SOS1 and KRAS as actionable targets.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Pharmacological inhibition with BI-3406 impaired RAS activation, reduced tumor burden in KRAS-mutant allografts and KRASG12D-driven LUAD model, and synergized with KRASG12D inhibitor.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: KRASG12D-driven LUAD immunocompetent mouse model and immunocompromised allograft models

validated_targets.experimental_detail: KRASG12D inhibitor MRTX1133 alone suppressed tumor growth in the LUAD model, and combined with SOS1 inhibitor yielded synergistic antitumor effects.

title: SOS1 inhibitor BI-3406 shows in vivo antitumor activity akin to genetic ablation and synergizes with a KRAS<sup>G12D</sup> inhibitor in KRAS LUAD.
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America

evidence_summary: Tarloxotinib-E inhibited phosphorylation of EGFR and HER2 and suppressed proliferation in patient-derived cancer cell lines; tarloxotinib prodrug induced tumor regression in murine xenograft models.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Tarloxotinib-E directly inhibited EGFR phosphorylation and reduced cell proliferation in patient-derived models; in vivo tarloxotinib caused tumor regression.
Tarloxotinib-E inhibited HER2 phosphorylation and HER2/HER3 heterodimer activation, suppressing cancer cell growth; xenograft models showed tumor regression.

title: Tarloxotinib Is a Hypoxia-Activated Pan-HER Kinase Inhibitor Active Against a Broad Range of HER-Family Oncogenes.
journal: Clinical cancer research : an official journal of the American Association for Cancer Research

evidence_summary: Epigenome-wide shRNA screen identified CBX5 loss as a driver of EGFR inhibitor resistance; CBX5 knockdown in EGFR-mutant LUAD cells and mice upregulated E2F1 and BIRC5, attenuating apoptosis; E2F1 or BIRC5 knockdown partially rescued sensitivity; BET inhibitors restored CBX5 expression and sensitized to EGFRi; BIRC5 inhibitor suppressed growth of resistant cells.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: CBX5 loss, identified via epigenome-wide shRNA screen, drives EGFRi resistance in EGFR-mutant LUAD cell lines and mice; CBX5 knockdown upregulates E2F1 and BIRC5, attenuating apoptosis following EGFRi treatment.
E2F1 is upregulated upon CBX5 loss; knockdown of E2F1 partly rescues EGFRi resistance induced by CBX5 knockdown in cell culture and mice.
BIRC5 (survivin) is upregulated via E2F1 in CBX5-knockdown cells; knockdown or pharmacological inhibition of BIRC5 suppresses growth of EGFRi-resistant LUAD cells.
BET-domain inhibitors (BETi) restore CBX5 expression in EGFRi-resistant LUAD cells and sensitize them to EGFRi/BETi combination therapy.

title: CBX5 loss drives EGFR inhibitor resistance and results in therapeutically actionable vulnerabilities in lung cancer.
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America

evidence_summary: BOK overexpression in A549 lung adenocarcinoma cells inhibited TGFβ-induced migration and EMT, supporting tumor suppressor function.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: BOK overexpression in A549 cells inhibited TGFβ-induced migration and epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EMT).

title: BOK displays cell death-independent tumor suppressor activity in non-small-cell lung carcinoma.

evidence_summary: In vivo selection of UCLA-P3 human lung adenocarcinoma cells in nude mice after treatment with monoclonal antibody-Vinca alkaloid immunoconjugate generated resistant variants; resistance was not associated with MDR1/P-glycoprotein upregulation.
title: In vivo selection of human tumor cells resistant to monoclonal antibody-Vinca alkaloid immunoconjugates.

evidence_summary: Treatment of A549 lung adenocarcinoma cells with NO donor diethylamine-NONOate increased immunoreactivity of latent and active TGF-beta1; NO nitrosylated recombinant LAP and interfered with its ability to neutralize active TGF-beta1, suggesting NO augments TGF-beta1 activity by modifying its natural inhibitor.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: NO donor treatment increased cell-associated latent and active TGF-beta1 immunoreactivity in A549 cells; nitrosylation of recombinant LAP by NO impaired its ability to neutralize active TGF-beta1.

title: Regulation of transforming growth factor beta1 by nitric oxide.

evidence_summary: Preclinical modeling of MET tyrosine kinase domain mutations confirmed oncogenic potential and differential sensitivity to type I and type II MET inhibitors, supporting clinical responses in lung adenocarcinoma patients.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Preclinical modeling confirmed oncogenic potential of MET kinase domain mutations and demonstrated differential sensitivity to type I and type II MET inhibitors.

title: Activating Point Mutations in the MET Kinase Domain Represent a Unique Molecular Subset of Lung Cancer and Other Malignancies Targetable with MET Inhibitors.

evidence_summary: In vitro: GSI-mediated Notch-1 inhibition induced apoptosis; IGF-1R overexpression rescued cells from apoptosis; dominant-negative IGF-1R and IRS-1 downregulation sensitized cells to GSI; ChIP confirmed Notch-1 binding to IGF1R promoter. In vivo: xenograft tumors showed co-expression of Notch-1(IC), IGF-1R, and pAkt-1 in hypoxic areas.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Inhibition of Notch-1 signaling by GSI caused apoptosis under hypoxia; forced Notch-1 expression upregulated IGF-1R.
Overexpression of IGF-1R protected ACL cells from GSI-induced apoptosis; dominant-negative IGF-1R sensitized cells; ChIP confirmed direct regulation by Notch-1.
Downregulation of IRS-1 sensitized ACL cells to GSI-induced apoptosis, indicating a pro-survival role.

title: Notch-1 stimulates survival of lung adenocarcinoma cells during hypoxia by activating the IGF-1R pathway.

evidence_summary: ACVR1 inhibitor treatment in EGFR-mutant lung adenocarcinoma mice converted the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment into a hot microenvironment and potently suppressed tumor growth.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Inhibiting ACVR1 with an inhibitor in EGFR-mutant lung adenocarcinoma mice converted the cold tumor microenvironment into a hot TME and suppressed tumor growth, establishing ACVR1 as a therapeutic target.

title: Protumor Macrophage Polarization Mediated by BMP2/4-ACVR1 Signaling Orchestrates an Immunosuppressive Microenvironment during Tumor Initiation.

evidence_summary: A cell-permeable peptidomimetic disrupted MFF-VDAC1 complex, triggering mitochondrial depolarization and cell death in cancer cells; in vivo, it showed anticancer activity in PDX, lung adenocarcinoma organoids, and glioblastoma neurospheres.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: MFF isoforms overexpressed in NSCLC; MFF peptidomimetic disrupted MFF-VDAC1 complex, causing mitochondrial depolarization and cell death, and inhibited tumor growth in PDX and organoid models.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Itga11 knockout in mouse embryonic fibroblasts reduced tumor growth of co-implanted A549 NSCLC cells; re-expression of human alpha11 rescued tumor growth.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: A549, NCI-H460, NCI-H520, Itga11 KO MEFs, immune-deficient mice

validated_targets.experimental_detail: IGF2 mRNA was >200-fold lower in A549+Itga11 KO fibroblast tumors; shRNA knockdown of IGF2 in WT fibroblasts decreased tumor growth of co-implanted A549 cells.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: A549, WT and Itga11 KO MEFs, immune-deficient mice

title: Integrin alpha 11 regulates IGF2 expression in fibroblasts to enhance tumorigenicity of human non-small-cell lung cancer cells.
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America

evidence_summary: TAE684 ALK inhibitor treatment in EML4-ALK-driven murine lung adenocarcinoma model caused tumor regression and improved overall survival compared to chemotherapy; HSP90 inhibitors induced EML4-ALK degradation in vitro and transient tumor regression in vivo.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: ALK inhibitor TAE684 treatment in EML4-ALK-driven murine lung adenocarcinoma model resulted in tumor regression and improved overall survival.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: genetically engineered mouse model with EML4-ALK fusion

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Geldanamycin-based HSP90 inhibitors caused rapid degradation of EML4-ALK in vitro and substantial but transient tumor regression in vivo.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: murine lung adenocarcinoma cells and genetically engineered mouse model

title: Inhibition of ALK, PI3K/MEK, and HSP90 in murine lung adenocarcinoma induced by EML4-ALK fusion oncogene.

title: Antitumor activity of P-4055 (elaidic acid-cytarabine) compared to cytarabine in metastatic and s.c. human tumor xenograft models.

evidence_summary: CRISPR/RNAi screening identified UXS1 as essential only in UGDH-high cells; UXS1 loss led to UDPGA accumulation, Golgi disruption, and impaired EGFR trafficking, validating a synthetic lethal metabolic vulnerability.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: UXS1 is essential only in cancer cells with high UGDH expression, where it detoxifies UDPGA; its loss causes Golgi disruption and blocks EGFR surface trafficking.
UGDH is elevated in lung adenocarcinoma and further enhanced during chemoresistance, rendering cells dependent on UXS1 for survival.

title: Disruption of sugar nucleotide clearance is a therapeutic vulnerability of cancer cells.

evidence_summary: Dual RNAi-mediated knockdown of BCL-2 and BCL-XL, and BH3 mimetic ABT-737 treatment eradicated EGFR inhibitor-resistant lung adenocarcinoma cells in vitro; xenograft model validated BCL-2 induction and showed that preemptive cotreatment with EGFR inhibitor and BH3 mimetic achieved durable response.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: BCL-2 induction was observed in residual tumor cells after EGFR inhibitor treatment in a xenograft model; dual RNAi knockdown of BCL-2 and BCL-XL, or treatment with BH3 mimetic ABT-737, eradicated early-resistant lung tumor cells.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: lung adenocarcinoma cell lines and xenograft model

validated_targets.experimental_detail: BCL-XL (encoded by BCL2L1) was targeted together with BCL-2 via dual RNAi-mediated knockdown, which eradicated early-resistant lung tumor cells; BH3 mimetic ABT-737 also disrupts BCL-XL.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: lung adenocarcinoma cell lines and xenograft model

title: MET-independent lung cancer cells evading EGFR kinase inhibitors are therapeutically susceptible to BH3 mimetic agents.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Inhibition of EGFR by ZD6474 in combination with SC-236 led to supra-additive growth inhibition in cancer cell lines and prolonged tumor growth inhibition in A549 and GEO xenografts.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: A549, GEO cell lines; nude mice xenografts

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Inhibition of VEGFR-2 (KDR) by ZD6474 in combination with SC-236 led to supra-additive growth inhibition in cancer cell lines and prolonged tumor growth inhibition in A549 and GEO xenografts.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: A549, GEO cell lines; nude mice xenografts

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Inhibition of COX-2 (PTGS2) by SC-236 in combination with ZD6474 led to supra-additive growth inhibition in cancer cell lines and prolonged tumor growth inhibition in A549 and GEO xenografts.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: A549, GEO cell lines; nude mice xenografts

title: Antitumor activity of ZD6474, a vascular endothelial growth factor-2 and epidermal growth factor receptor small molecule tyrosine kinase inhibitor, in combination with SC-236, a cyclooxygenase-2 inhibitor.
journal: Clinical cancer research : an official journal of the American Association for Cancer Research

evidence_summary: Gprc5a knockout in mouse lung epithelial cells enhanced survival and colony formation with persistent Stat3 phosphorylation; AG490 and dominant-negative Stat3 inhibited Stat3 and reversed the phenotype, validating Gprc5a as a tumor suppressor and Stat3 as an oncogenic driver.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Deletion of Gprc5a in mouse lung epithelial cells enhanced survival, colony formation, and persistent Stat3 activation, indicating tumor suppressive function.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: Gprc5a knockout mouse lung epithelial cells

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Inhibition of Stat3 by AG490 or dominant-negative Stat3 increased apoptosis and inhibited colony formation in Gprc5a-/- cells, demonstrating its role in survival and transformation.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: Gprc5a-/- mouse lung epithelial cells, lung adenocarcinoma cells from Gprc5a-/- mice

title: Gprc5a deletion enhances the transformed phenotype in normal and malignant lung epithelial cells by eliciting persistent Stat3 signaling induced by autocrine leukemia inhibitory factor.

evidence_summary: Depletion of TNFR2, c-Rel, or TNF in CD4+ T cells or monocyte-derived macrophages dampened Treg generation and lung tumorigenesis; Treg depletion also attenuated carcinogenesis.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Depletion of TNFR2 in CD4+ T cells or monocyte-derived macrophages dampened Treg generation and lung tumorigenesis.
Depletion of c-Rel in CD4+ T cells or monocyte-derived macrophages dampened Treg generation and lung tumorigenesis.
Depletion of TNF in CD4+ T cells or monocyte-derived macrophages dampened Treg generation and lung tumorigenesis.

title: IKKα-deficient lung adenocarcinomas generate an immunosuppressive microenvironment by overproducing Treg-inducing cytokines.
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America

evidence_summary: CSF treatment (G-CSF, GM-CSF, M-CSF) increased MMP-2, MMP-9, and uPA activity, and enhanced invasive capacity of human lung adenocarcinoma cell lines.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Treatment with G-CSF increased gelatinase (MMP-2, MMP-9) and uPA activity, and promoted invasion in human lung adenocarcinoma cell lines.
Treatment with GM-CSF increased gelatinase (MMP-2, MMP-9) and uPA activity, and promoted invasion in human lung adenocarcinoma cell lines.
Treatment with M-CSF increased gelatinase (MMP-2, MMP-9) and uPA activity, and promoted invasion in human lung adenocarcinoma cell lines.

title: Granulocyte, granulocyte-macrophage, and macrophage colony-stimulating factors can stimulate the invasive capacity of human lung cancer cells.

evidence_summary: Knockout of A20 in mouse lung tumors enhanced tumorigenesis and reduced CD8+ T cell surveillance via TBK1-STAT1-PD-L1 axis; IFNAR knockout restored T cell infiltration and rescued A20-dependent tumorigenesis, and immune checkpoint blockade was efficient in A20-deficient tumors.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Tumor cell intrinsic loss of A20 in mouse models enhanced lung tumorigenesis and reduced CD8+ T cell-mediated immune surveillance, rescued by IFNAR knockout.
A20 loss led to aberrant TBK1 activation, increased STAT1, and high PD-L1 expression; disrupting the loop by IFNAR knockout restored T cell infiltration.

title: Down-regulation of A20 promotes immune escape of lung adenocarcinomas.

evidence_summary: IL-8 neutralizing antibody inhibited osteoclast formation by 60% in conditioned media from MDA-MET breast cancer and A549 lung adenocarcinoma cells, while RANKL pathway blockade had no effect, confirming IL-8 as a key osteoclastogenic factor.
disease: Bone metastasis in breast cancer and lung adenocarcinoma

validated_targets.experimental_detail: IL-8 neutralizing antibody inhibited 60% of osteoclast formation induced by conditioned medium from MDA-MET and A549 cells; IL-8 mRNA expression was higher in cell lines with higher in vivo osteolytic potential.

title: Tumor-derived interleukin-8 stimulates osteolysis independent of the receptor activator of nuclear factor-kappaB ligand pathway.

evidence_summary: Methylation-specific SSCP and benzo(a)pyrene induction experiments in A549 and Beas-2B lung cell lines and clinical lung tissues showed that CYP1A1 promoter methylation is associated with tobacco smoking and inversely correlates with CYP1A1 inducibility.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Benzo(a)pyrene treatment in A549 and Beas-2B cells revealed that cells with less promoter methylation showed higher CYP1A1 induction; in lung tissue, unmethylated promoter was associated with higher EROD activity in smokers.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: A549, Beas-2B, normal lung tissue, peripheral WBCs

title: Methylation of cytochrome P4501A1 promoter in the lung is associated with tobacco smoking.

evidence_summary: JSI-124 inhibited JAK/STAT3 signaling, suppressed phosphotyrosine STAT3 and JAK, blocked STAT3 DNA binding and transcriptional activity, and inhibited tumor growth in A549 xenograft and other cancer models.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: JSI-124 reduced phosphotyrosine STAT3 levels, inhibited STAT3 DNA binding and STAT3-mediated transcription, and suppressed tumor growth in A549 xenograft.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: A549, v-Src-transformed NIH 3T3, MDA-MB-468, Calu-1, murine melanoma

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Selective pharmacological inhibition of JAK/STAT3 signaling by JSI-124 resulted in potent antitumor activity across multiple cancer cell lines and xenografts.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: A549, v-Src-transformed NIH 3T3, MDA-MB-468, murine melanoma

title: Discovery of JSI-124 (cucurbitacin I), a selective Janus kinase/signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 signaling pathway inhibitor with potent antitumor activity against human and murine cancer cells in mice.

evidence_summary: Depletion of surface heparan sulfates blocked SARS-CoV-2 E484D variant infection in H522 lung adenocarcinoma cells, identifying heparan sulfate as a necessary host factor for alternative virus entry.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Depletion of surface heparan sulfates completely blocked SARS-CoV-2 E484D spike variant infection in ACE2-negative H522 cells.

title: Systematic analysis of SARS-CoV-2 infection of an ACE2-negative human airway cell.

evidence_summary: Drug-resistant HCT116 colon and A549 lung adenocarcinoma cell lines generated by repeated etoposide/teniposide exposure showed elevated mdr1 (ABCB1) expression in one line and decreased topoisomerase II (TOP2A) expression in three other lines, as measured by DNA probe hybridization, antibody detection, and enzyme activity assay.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Elevated mdr1 (ABCB1) mRNA and P-glycoprotein levels were detected in HCT116(VM)34 teniposide-resistant cells.
Decreased topoisomerase II mRNA and enzyme activity observed in HCT116(VP)35, A549(VP)28, and A549(VM)28 resistant cell lines.

title: Mechanisms of resistance to etoposide and teniposide in acquired resistant human colon and lung carcinoma cell lines.

evidence_summary: In vivo CRISPR-Cas9 screening identified KRAS-induced COX2 as a key mediator of immune evasion; KRAS inhibitors suppressed COX2, and targeting COX2/PGE2 pathway remodeled the tumor microenvironment to enhance immune checkpoint blockade efficacy in lung adenocarcinoma.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Oncogenic KRAS induced COX2 upregulation, and KRAS inhibitors suppressed COX2 expression in mouse and human lung cancer.

COX2 (PTGS2) is upregulated by oncogenic KRAS and promotes resistance to immune checkpoint blockade via prostaglandin E2; targeting COX2/PGE2 remodeled the tumor microenvironment and enhanced ICB efficacy.
COX2/PGE2 pathway was targeted to overcome immunotherapy resistance; its inhibition led to proinflammatory myeloid polarization and increased CD8+ T cell influx, improving ICB response.

title: CRISPR-Cas9 Screening Identifies KRAS-Induced COX2 as a Driver of Immunotherapy Resistance in Lung Cancer.

evidence_summary: Ectopic expression of NKX2-1 in p53 wild-type lung adenocarcinoma cells reduced soft-agar growth and invasion, while siRNA silencing of NKX2-1 in p53-mutated cells elevated growth and invasion, confirming NKX2-1's functional role in tumor malignancy.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Ectopic NKX2-1 in p53 wild-type cells suppressed soft-agar growth and invasion; siRNA silencing of NKX2-1 in p53-mutated cells increased soft-agar growth and invasion.

title: LKB1 loss by alteration of the NKX2-1/p53 pathway promotes tumor malignancy and predicts poor survival and relapse in lung adenocarcinomas.

evidence_summary: shRNA knockdown of SMAD2 or SMAD3 in patient-derived tumour-associated fibroblasts and control fibroblasts in 3D microfluidic collagen migration assays demonstrated that high SMAD3 enhances migration and protrusion formation via ERK1/2 hyperactivation, while high SMAD2 impairs migration; the MEK inhibitor Trametinib abrogated the pro-migratory advantage.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: shRNA-mediated SMAD3 knockdown impaired fibroblast migration; conversely, high SMAD3 condition (shSMAD2 or ADC-TAFs) conferred a migration advantage that was dependent on ERK1/2 hyperactivation and sensitive to the MEK inhibitor Trametinib.
High SMAD2 fibroblasts (achieved by shSMAD3) displayed impaired migration and poor responsiveness to TGF-β1, glucose, and Trametinib, indicating a negative regulatory role in fibroblast recruitment.
ERK1/2 hyperactivation was associated with high SMAD3-driven migration, and the MEK inhibitor Trametinib abrogated this enhanced migration.

title: 3D collagen migration patterns reveal a SMAD3-dependent and TGF-β1-independent mechanism of recruitment for tumour-associated fibroblasts in lung adenocarcinoma.

evidence_summary: In a mouse model of lung adenocarcinoma, ERV-reactive antibodies extended survival, therapeutic CXCL13 treatment potentiated anti-tumor immunity and synergized with ICB, and targeted KRAS(G12C) inhibition amplified ERV-targeting B cell responses.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: ERV-reactive antibodies exerted anti-tumour activity that extended survival in a mouse model, and ERV expression predicted ICB outcome in human lung adenocarcinoma; ERV-targeting B cell responses were amplified by ICB and by targeted KRAS(G12C) inhibition.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: mouse model for lung adenocarcinoma, human lung adenocarcinoma cohorts

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Therapeutic CXCL13 treatment potentiated anti-tumour immunity and synergized with ICB in a mouse model of lung adenocarcinoma, and effective immunotherapy required CXCL13-dependent TLS formation.
Targeted inhibition of KRAS(G12C) amplified ERV-targeting B cell responses in a mouse model of lung adenocarcinoma.

title: Antibodies against endogenous retroviruses promote lung cancer immunotherapy.

evidence_summary: Isogenic cell lines expressing different KRAS mutant isoforms were used to assess isoform-specific oncogenic properties and drug sensitivity; MEK inhibitor treatment revealed differential responses, and combined KRAS G12C plus MEK inhibition enhanced in vivo efficacy.
validation_methods: drug treatment (MEK inhibitor, KRAS G12C inhibitor)

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Isogenic cell lines expressing various KRAS mutant isoforms exhibited isoform-specific oncogenic properties and differential sensitivity to MEK inhibitors.
MEK inhibitor treatment suppressed oncogenic properties in a KRAS isoform-dependent manner; combined KRAS G12C and MEK inhibition was more effective than either alone in vivo.

title: Comparative Analysis and Isoform-Specific Therapeutic Vulnerabilities of KRAS Mutations in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer.
journal: Clinical cancer research : an official journal of the American Association for Cancer Research

evidence_summary: Inhibition of AhR signaling sensitized EGFR-TKI-resistant NSCLC cells, while AhR activation conferred resistance via Src-mediated PI3K/Akt and MEK/Erk restoration; in vivo and IHC validated clinical relevance.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Inhibition of AhR signaling sensitized NSCLC cells to EGFR TKIs, while AhR activation rendered EGFR-mutant cells resistant to TKIs by restoring PI3K/Akt and MEK/Erk signaling through Src activation.
AhR acts as a protein adaptor to mediate Jak2-SRC interaction, leading to SRC activation that drives bypass signaling; targeting SRC is proposed to overcome EGFR TKI resistance.

title: Activation of the Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor Leads to Resistance to EGFR TKIs in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer by Activating Src-mediated Bypass Signaling.
journal: Clinical cancer research : an official journal of the American Association for Cancer Research

evidence_summary: Topotecan treatment in gastric/esophageal cancer patients led to cleavable complex formation with topoisomerase I, reducing free TOP1 protein levels in tumor biopsies as measured by Western blot, validating target engagement in a clinical setting.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Following topotecan administration, Western blot with heat reversal detected high-molecular-weight cleavable complexes and a significant reduction in noncomplexed TOP1 copy number in patient tumor biopsies, confirming drug-target interaction.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: gastric and esophageal cancer patient biopsies

title: Pharmacodynamics of topoisomerase I inhibition: Western blot determination of topoisomerase I and cleavable complex in patients with upper gastrointestinal malignancies treated with topotecan.
journal: Clinical cancer research : an official journal of the American Association for Cancer Research

evidence_summary: Treatment with lysosomal inhibitor NH4Cl or autophagy inhibitor 3-methyladenine rescued ZIKV-induced AXL and TIM-1 downregulation, demonstrating autophagy involvement; downregulation promoted sustained viral replication and spread validated by viral assays.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: ZIKV infection downregulated AXL protein expression in A549, U87, and trophoblast cells; downregulation was mitigated by autophagy inhibitor 3-methyladenine, confirming autophagy-mediated degradation.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: A549, U87, embryonic stem cell-derived trophoblasts

validated_targets.experimental_detail: ZIKV infection mildly downregulated TIM-1 (HAVCR1) expression; lysosomal inhibitor NH4Cl and autophagy inhibitor mitigated downregulation, indicating autophagic degradation.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: A549, U87, embryonic stem cell-derived trophoblasts

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Inhibition of autophagy with 3-methyladenine prevented AXL/TIM-1 downregulation, demonstrating that autophagy mediates receptor degradation to promote sustained viral infection.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: A549, U87, embryonic stem cell-derived trophoblasts

title: Autophagy-mediated downregulation of AXL and TIM-1 promotes sustained Zika virus infection.
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America

evidence_summary: ISR inhibitors substantially reduced tumor growth and prolonged survival in KRAS-driven lung cancer mouse models, confirming ISR as a tumorigenic driver.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Treatment with ISR inhibitors substantially reduced tumor growth and prolonged survival in KRAS-driven lung cancer mice.

title: The integrated stress response is tumorigenic and constitutes a therapeutic liability in KRAS-driven lung cancer.

evidence_summary: MTT assay revealed cross-resistance to tumor promoters (TPA, aplysiatoxin, okadaic acid) in drug-resistant K562/ADM leukemia and PC-9/CDDP lung adenocarcinoma cells; 3H-okadaic acid accumulation similar in resistant and parental cells, indicating non-accumulation resistance mechanism.
title: Cross-resistance to tumour promoters in human cancer cell lines resistant to adriamycin or cisplatin.

evidence_summary: Luciferase reporter assays confirmed miR-34 directly targets PDL1 3'UTR; therapeutic delivery of miR-34a-loaded liposomes (MRX34) plus radiotherapy modulated tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes and macrophages in a syngeneic mouse model of lung adenocarcinoma.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Direct binding of miR-34a, miR-34b, and miR-34c to PDL1 3'UTR was validated by luciferase assays showing reduced reporter activity.
In vivo delivery of miR-34a-loaded liposomes (MRX34) combined with radiotherapy increased CD8+ TILs, reduced CD8+PD1+ cells and macrophages, and decreased Tregs.

title: PDL1 Regulation by p53 via miR-34.
journal: Journal of the National Cancer Institute

evidence_summary: DNA from spontaneous mouse tumors was tested in NIH 3T3 focus assays and nude mouse tumorigenicity assays; activated HRAS, KRAS, and NRAS genes with specific point mutations were identified by Southern blot, confirming their transforming activity.
disease: spontaneous non-liver tumors in B6C3F1 mice

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Activating mutations in HRAS codon 61 detected in Harderian gland adenoma DNA conferred transforming activity in NIH 3T3 focus assay.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: NIH 3T3 cells, B6C3F1 mouse spontaneous Harderian gland adenomas

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Activating mutations in KRAS codon 12 identified in pulmonary adenocarcinoma and subcutaneous adenocarcinoma DNAs showed transforming activity in NIH 3T3 focus assay.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: NIH 3T3 cells, B6C3F1 mouse spontaneous pulmonary adenocarcinoma and subcutaneous adenocarcinoma

validated_targets.experimental_detail: An activating NRAS codon 12 mutation detected in lymphoma DNA conferred tumorigenicity in the nude mouse tumorigenicity assay.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: nude mice, NIH 3T3 cells, B6C3F1 mouse spontaneous lymphoma

title: Activation of protooncogenes in spontaneously occurring non-liver tumors from C57BL/6 x C3H F1 mice.

evidence_summary: Hypoxia-induced K63-polyubiquitination of DDX17 by E3 ligase HectH9 disassociates DDX17 from the Drosha-DGCR8 complex, reduces anti-stemness miRNA biogenesis, and promotes association with p300-YAP leading to H3K56 acetylation and transcription of stemness genes; functional assays demonstrated control of stem-like properties and tumor-initiating capabilities.
disease: head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, lung adenocarcinoma

validated_targets.experimental_detail: HectH9 mediates K63-polyubiquitination of DDX17 under hypoxia, promoting disassociation from the Drosha-DGCR8 complex and association with p300-YAP, which decreases anti-stemness miRNA biogenesis and activates stemness gene transcription to enhance stem-like features and tumor-initiating capabilities.

K63-polyubiquitinated DDX17 disassociates from the Drosha-DGCR8 complex leading to reduced biogenesis of anti-stemness miRNAs and increased association with p300-YAP to acetylate H3K56 at stemness gene promoters, thereby activating transcription and promoting cancer stem-like features.

title: Regulation of miRNA Biogenesis and Histone Modification by K63-Polyubiquitinated DDX17 Controls Cancer Stem-like Features.
Expression of MDA-7/IL-24 and its clinical significance in resected non-small cell lung cancer.
journal: Clinical cancer research : an official journal of the American Association for Cancer Research

evidence_summary: Genetic deletion of PKCα in murine lung adenocarcinoma models increased tumor burden and decreased survival; p38 inhibitor treatment in BASCs mimicked PKCα loss, and TGFβR1 inhibitor reversed the growth enhancement, validating the PKCα-p38-TGFβ tumor suppressor axis.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Genetic deletion of PRKCA in LSL-Kras, LA2-Kras and urethane-exposed mice significantly increased lung tumor number, size, burden, grade, and decreased survival, with expansion of BASCs.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: LSL-Kras, LA2-Kras, urethane-induced mice; primary LSL-Kras BASCs

validated_targets.experimental_detail: p38 inhibitor treatment in LSL-Kras BASCs increased colony size, indistinguishable from PRKCA knockout, and phospho-p38 was reduced in PRKCA-null BASCs and tumors.
TGFβ1 mRNA was increased in PRKCA-null BASCs; exogenous TGFβ1 enhanced growth, and a TGFβR1 inhibitor reversed the enhanced growth of PRKCA knockout BASCs.

title: Protein kinase Cα suppresses Kras-mediated lung tumor formation through activation of a p38 MAPK-TGFβ signaling axis.

evidence_summary: PREP1 overexpression and downregulation in human NSCLC cells demonstrated induction of EMT through SMAD3 nuclear translocation and FRA-1/PBX1 expression; in vivo lung colonization assay confirmed prometastatic activity, and IHC showed PREP1 accumulation in brain metastases.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Overexpression triggers EMT, downregulation inhibits TGF-β-induced EMT, and overexpression promotes lung colonization in vivo.
PREP1 induces FRA-1 expression; FRA-1 is required for PREP1-induced mesenchymal changes in lung tumor cells.
PREP1 stabilizes and accumulates PBX1; PBX1 is required for PREP1-induced mesenchymal changes in lung tumor cells.

title: Transcription factor PREP1 induces EMT and metastasis by controlling the TGF-β-SMAD3 pathway in non-small cell lung adenocarcinoma.
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America

evidence_summary: SOX2 silencing in EGFR-mutant lung cancer cells induced vimentin, suppressed BCL2L11, and promoted EGFR-TKI tolerance; ectopic SOX2 expression interfered with TGFβ-induced EMT; TGFβ stimulation downregulated SOX2 and increased TKI tolerance.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: SOX2 silencing induced vimentin, suppressed BCL2L11, and promoted TKI tolerance; ectopic SOX2 expression inhibited TGFβ-induced EMT and TKI tolerance; low SOX2 associated with worse survival.
TGFβ stimulation downregulated SOX2, induced epithelial-to-mesenchymal transdifferentiation, and increased EGFR-TKI tolerance.

title: Cross-talk between SOX2 and TGFβ Signaling Regulates EGFR-TKI Tolerance and Lung Cancer Dissemination.

evidence_summary: Exogenous human interferons (alpha, beta, gamma) and TGF-beta inhibited colony formation of human lung adenocarcinoma A549 cells in soft agar, and anti-IFN serum promoted C-243 tumor growth in mice, validating their roles as negative growth regulators in vitro and in vivo.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Exogenous human IFN-alpha inhibited colony formation of A549 cells in soft agar in a dose-dependent manner; combination with anti-IFN serum in mice confirmed endogenous IFN-alpha's tumor-suppressive role.
Exogenous human IFN-beta inhibited colony formation of A549 cells in soft agar; synergy with TGF-beta was observed.
Exogenous human IFN-gamma inhibited colony formation of A549 cells in soft agar.
Exogenous TGF-beta inhibited colony formation of A549 cells in soft agar and synergized with IFN-beta.

title: Interactions of interferons and transforming growth factors during clonal growth of mouse or human cells in soft agar and in mice.

evidence_summary: Expression of endogenous Braf(D631A) kinase‑inactive mutant in mice triggered lung adenocarcinoma; co‑expression with Kras(G12V) enhanced tumor initiation via Craf kinase; ablation of wild‑type Braf prevented tumor development by increasing MAPK signaling causing oncogenic toxicity, rescued by pharmacological Mek inhibition.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Expression of endogenous Braf(D631A) kinase‑inactive isoform (corresponding to human BRAF(D594A)) in mice triggered lung adenocarcinoma in vivo.
Co‑expression of Kras(G12V) and Braf(D631A) in mouse lung cells markedly enhanced tumour initiation.
The enhanced tumour initiation by co‑expressed Kras(G12V) and Braf(D631A) was mediated by Craf (RAF1) kinase activity.

Ablation of the wild‑type Braf allele prevented lung adenocarcinoma development by inducing a further increase in MAPK signalling that caused oncogenic toxicity; wild‑type Braf is required to sustain Kras/Braf‑driven tumours.
Pharmacological inhibition of Mek (MAP2K1) restored tumour growth after wild‑type Braf ablation, demonstrating Mek is a critical effector of the oncogenic toxicity.

Ablation of wild‑type Braf caused a further increase in MAPK signalling leading to oncogenic toxicity, highlighting that the intensity of MAPK pathway is a determinant of tumor development and phenotype.

title: A Braf kinase-inactive mutant induces lung adenocarcinoma.

evidence_summary: CRISPR-Cas9-mediated Keap1 knockout in a mouse model of KRAS-driven LUAD promoted tumor progression; genetic screening and metabolomic analyses revealed dependency on glutaminolysis; pharmacological glutaminase inhibition showed therapeutic potential.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: CRISPR-Cas9-mediated Keap1 loss in mouse model of KRAS-driven LUAD promoted lung cancer progression.
Nrf2-mutant cancers derived from genetic screening showed dependency on increased glutaminolysis.
Pharmacological inhibition of glutaminase exploited glutaminolysis dependency in Keap1- or Nrf2-mutant cancers.

title: Keap1 loss promotes Kras-driven lung cancer and results in dependence on glutaminolysis.

evidence_summary: siRNA-mediated MALAT1 knockdown decreased GINS1 expression and inhibited NSCLC proliferation in vitro and in vivo; GINS1 overexpression reversed this inhibition, validating the oncogenic MALAT1-FOXP3-GINS1 regulatory axis.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Silencing of MALAT1 decreased GINS1 expression and inhibited NSCLC proliferation in vitro and in vivo.
Upregulation of GINS1 reversed the proliferation inhibition caused by MALAT1 knockdown in NSCLC.
MALAT1 stabilized FOXP3 by masking its ubiquitination domain, promoting GINS1 transcription and driving NSCLC proliferation.

title: MALAT1 modulated FOXP3 ubiquitination then affected GINS1 transcription and drived NSCLC proliferation.

evidence_summary: Z-TMS treatment in C57BL/6 mice with DEN/CCl4-induced liver injury reduced DCLK1 expression and improved histology; in hepatoma cells, Z-TMS downregulated CDK1, upregulated p21, inhibited Akt phosphorylation, and blocked cell-cycle progression; in H1975 lung adenocarcinoma cells, Z-TMS inhibited proliferation and induced autophagy.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Z-TMS reduced DCLK1 expression in DEN/CCl4-injured mouse livers and caused DCLK1 bundling with microtubules in hepatoma cells.
Z-TMS downregulated CDK1 expression in hepatoma cells, contributing to G2-M cell-cycle arrest.
Z-TMS induced p21(cip1/waf1) expression in hepatoma cells, mediating cell-cycle arrest.
Z-TMS inhibited Akt(Ser473) phosphorylation in hepatoma cells, suppressing survival signaling.

title: (Z)-3,5,4'-Trimethoxystilbene Limits Hepatitis C and Cancer Pathophysiology by Blocking Microtubule Dynamics and Cell-Cycle Progression.

evidence_summary: TGFβ stimulation of tumor cells increased SHP1 phosphatase activity in an AKT-Smad3-dependent manner, decreasing IFNγ-mediated JAK1/2 and STAT1 phosphorylation and suppressing PD-L1, IDO1, HVEM, and galectin-9 expression; in a mouse model, dual TGFβ and PD-L1 blockade showed antitumor activity but prolonged treatment caused resistance with upregulated immune evasion genes, while JAK1/2 inhibitor after anti-PD-L1 suppressed tumor growth.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: TGFβ stimulation of tumor cells increased SHP1 activity via AKT-Smad3, suppressing IFNγ-JAK/STAT signaling; TGFβ blockade combined with anti-PD-L1 showed antitumor activity but later resistance with increased immune evasion gene expression.
AKT activity was required for TGFβ-induced SHP1 phosphatase activation and subsequent suppression of IFNγ signaling.
SMAD3 was required for TGFβ-induced SHP1 phosphatase activation and downstream inhibition of IFNγ-mediated JAK/STAT signaling.
JAK1/2 inhibitor treatment after anti-PD-L1 therapy suppressed tumor growth and downregulated immune evasion gene expression in a mouse model.
JAK1/2 inhibitor treatment after anti-PD-L1 therapy suppressed tumor growth and downregulated immune evasion gene expression in a mouse model.

PD-L1 expression increased in tumors with acquired resistance to combined TGFβ and PD-L1 blockade; anti-PD-L1 therapy combined with TGFβ blockade or followed by JAK1/2 inhibitor modulated PD-L1 levels.

title: TGFβ Antagonizes IFNγ-Mediated Adaptive Immune Evasion via Activation of the AKT-Smad3-SHP1 Axis in Lung Adenocarcinoma.

evidence_summary: miR-340 overexpression in lung adenocarcinoma cells inhibited proliferation, induced apoptosis, and increased p27 protein; miR-340 directly targets PUM1, PUM2, SKP2, MET, ROCK1, RHOA, and CDH1; siRNA knockdown of PUM1 or SKP2 partially recapitulated miR-340's tumor-suppressive effects; miR-340 expression inversely correlated with clinical staging in NSCLC patients.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Overexpression of miR-340 in lung adenocarcinoma cells inhibited proliferation, induced apoptosis, and increased p27 protein; miR-340 expression inversely correlated with clinical staging in NSCLC patients.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: lung adenocarcinoma cell lines and NSCLC patient tissues (n=23)

validated_targets.experimental_detail: miR-340 directly targets PUM1 mRNA; siRNA-mediated knockdown of PUM1 partially recapitulated miR-340-induced inhibition of proliferation and apoptosis.
miR-340 directly targets PUM2 mRNA, contributing to the derepression of p27 translation.
miR-340 directly targets SKP2; siRNA-mediated knockdown of SKP2 partially recapitulated miR-340-induced stabilization of p27 and inhibition of proliferation and apoptosis.
miR-340 overexpression inhibited MET transcript levels in lung cancer cells.
miR-340 overexpression inhibited ROCK1 transcript levels in lung cancer cells.
miR-340 overexpression inhibited RHOA transcript levels in lung cancer cells.
miR-340 overexpression inhibited CDH1 transcript levels in lung cancer cells.

title: miR-340 inhibits tumor cell proliferation and induces apoptosis by targeting multiple negative regulators of p27 in non-small cell lung cancer.
